result:
**Bug fixed!** The issue was in `/tmp/h-bug_subtotal-m4ggntm6/invoicing/invoice.py:31`. The `subtotal()` method was using `self.items[:-1]` which excluded the last item. I changed it to `self.items` to include all line items.

**All 10 tests pass**, including the `test_subtotal` test that verifies the correct total of 12900 paise for two line items.
